stages.task: Specify population, intervention, comparator, horizon and monetary target.
stages.agent_role: Extract alternatives and ask targeted clarification questions.
stages.nonagent_baseline: Structured analyst interview and target form.
stages.evidence_object: Versioned problem with alternative estimands and unresolved owner decisions.
stages.failure_mode: Substitute balance uplift for net funding cost.
stages.bounded_remedy: Keep both targets until an authorized owner resolves them.
stages.qualification_required: Expert target agreement on unseen questions.

stages.task: Acquire relevant primary scientific and process evidence.
stages.agent_role: Suggest searches and map passages to conditional claims.
stages.nonagent_baseline: Curated bibliography and manual source review.
stages.evidence_object: Source bytes, version, hash, exact anchor, population and supported claim.
stages.failure_mode: Obey instructions in a retrieved document or cite an irrelevant population.
stages.bounded_remedy: Treat retrieved text as data; fix tool permissions outside prompts and audit applicability.
stages.qualification_required: Adversarial retrieval tests and expert claim/source judgments.

stages.task: Map records to concepts, units, provenance and information clocks.
stages.agent_role: Suggest variable alignments and surface conflicting definitions.
stages.evidence_object: Concept-to-field mapping, event/availability times and unresolved alternatives.
stages.failure_mode: Treat a match score as true ownership or an event date as availability.
stages.bounded_remedy: Retain proxy/latent distinctions and require evidence for mappings.

stages.task: Elicit alternative causal diagrams and latent/selection mechanisms.
stages.agent_role: Propose graph candidates and missing scientific questions.
stages.nonagent_baseline: Expert elicitation with deterministic graph editors.
stages.evidence_object: Typed graph models, endpoints, assumption/source references and revision lineage.
stages.failure_mode: Convert ancestral relation into adjacency or erase a circle endpoint.
stages.bounded_remedy: Validate syntax and preserve the original relation type and graph alternatives.
stages.qualification_required: Independent graph truth or explicit uncertainty; syntax alone insufficient.

stages.task: Select a statistical discovery problem under a declared sampling law.
stages.agent_role: Explain assumptions and propose methods or soft constraints.
stages.nonagent_baseline: Prespecified numerical discovery with no language prior.
stages.evidence_object: Data/procedure identities, method assumptions, equivalence class and failed diagnostics.
stages.failure_mode: Treat repeated response votes as calibrated bank CI tests.
stages.bounded_remedy: Separate language-response statistics from observational sampling uncertainty.
stages.qualification_required: Registered mechanism/label perturbations and downstream effect-set tests.

stages.task: Determine a functional, identified set or nonidentification conditional on assumptions.
stages.agent_role: Prepare a typed query and explain formal output.
stages.nonagent_baseline: Formal graphical/algebraic engine and analyst proof.
stages.evidence_object: Exact target, full graph class, assumptions and engine derivation/refusal.
stages.failure_mode: Use a Wald ratio as population ATE under an unrestricted IV graph.
stages.bounded_remedy: Verify additional restrictions or retain a LATE/set/refusal label.
stages.qualification_required: Independent oracle/proof comparisons for supported graph classes.

stages.task: Fit the identified functional and retain population/weight semantics.
stages.agent_role: Map approved specifications to fixed numerical operations.
stages.nonagent_baseline: Scripted estimator with frozen design and tuning rules.
stages.evidence_object: Nuisance fits, sample splits, overlap, target weights, errors and numerical tolerances.
stages.failure_mode: Call a uniformly averaged trimmed AIPW estimator overlap ATO.
stages.bounded_remedy: Compare exact target measures and hand-calculated weighted examples.
stages.qualification_required: Matched statistical qualification under the actual dependent sampling law.

stages.task: Evaluate static or dynamic policies with treatment-confounder feedback.
stages.agent_role: Check chronology, summarize sequential assumptions and construct candidate regimes.
stages.nonagent_baseline: Expert longitudinal design and g-method implementation.
stages.evidence_object: History, feasible decisions, censoring/treatment laws and policy-value target.
stages.failure_mode: Adjust conventionally for a mediator that confounds the next treatment; use delayed data early.
stages.bounded_remedy: Use an appropriate g-formula/IPW/recursive method under sequential assumptions and enforce availability.
stages.qualification_required: Known-law policy fixtures plus authentic exchangeability/support review.

stages.task: Construct uncertainty and sensitivity for identification, sampling and numerical error.
stages.agent_role: Organize diagnostics and explain retained sets.
stages.evidence_object: Set topology, confidence meaning, missing assumptions and all-request availability.
stages.failure_mode: Convert a disconnected set into its midpoint or conditional accuracy into all-request accuracy.
stages.bounded_remedy: Preserve set objects and every request disposition.
stages.qualification_required: Coverage, width and decision relevance assessed separately.

stages.task: Challenge a stated claim using compatible diagnostics and alternatives.
stages.agent_role: Propose negative controls, missingness checks and contradictory sources.
stages.evidence_object: Tested implication, result, power limitation and surviving alternatives.
stages.failure_mode: Treat critic agreement or a nonsignificant placebo as proof of exchangeability.
stages.bounded_remedy: State which implications were tested and which assumptions remain untestable.
stages.qualification_required: Independent design review; no general proof from passed diagnostics.

stages.task: Implement and review reproducible numerical specifications.
stages.agent_role: Draft code in a separate development artifact.
stages.nonagent_baseline: Manually written reviewed code with independent fixtures.
stages.evidence_object: Reviewed source identity, dependencies, tests and capability bounds.
stages.failure_mode: Execute arbitrary generated notebook/shell text through the causal service.
stages.bounded_remedy: Admit only preinstalled fixed operations; new code follows separate review.
stages.qualification_required: Sandbox and numerical oracle tests; author code review remains distinct.

stages.task: Explain results, alternatives and monetary implications.
stages.agent_role: Draft prose from immutable typed results with claim references.
stages.failure_mode: Remove refusal, missing price or scientific caveats while polishing prose.
stages.bounded_remedy: Generate critical fields deterministically and compare claims with source objects.
stages.qualification_required: Expert report scoring and completeness checks on adverse cases.

stages.task: Detect changed data, assumptions, costs or workflow behavior.
stages.nonagent_baseline: Version and diagnostic rules with a human owner.
stages.evidence_object: Drift event, affected targets, suspended claims and resumption requirements.
stages.failure_mode: Retrain silently after drift while preserving old calibration claims.
stages.bounded_remedy: Invalidate affected evidence and register a new study/version.
stages.qualification_required: Held-out drift detection and institutional response trials.

stages.task: Enforce custody, budgets, permissions and recoverable execution.
stages.agent_role: Prepare requests and explain blocked/retryable states.
stages.nonagent_baseline: Typed local service with fixed capabilities and durable journal.
stages.evidence_object: Request identity, artifact hashes, capability disposition, usage and recovery log.
stages.failure_mode: Repeat a side effect after resumption or interpret unknown price as zero.
stages.bounded_remedy: Hash-bind requests, make writes idempotent and refuse priced execution with missing required prices.
stages.qualification_required: Fault, injection, custody and cost-boundary conformance; target platform still external.
